## Contract

<!-- A feature links its spec. A fix, chore or docs change fills in the four lines below. -->

- **Spec:** `specs/NNN-slug/`, or none
- **Deliverable:**
- **Constraints:**
- **Non-goals:**
- **Acceptance:**

## Checklist

- [ ] No real data in the diff or the commit messages: company or product names, account
      IDs, profile names, hostnames, IP addresses, channel or user IDs, ticket keys, alert
      texts, costs or contact details (rule 1).
- [ ] Tests came first, and `uv run just check` passes.
- [ ] New host-specific code sits behind a port (ADR-0021), or there is none.
- [ ] A cross-cutting decision has an ADR in `docs/adr/`, or there is none.
- [ ] If specified behavior changed, the spec is updated in this pull request.
